text:
anya: quick heads-up — overnight link-scan found ~22 dead links (404/403) across runtime guide + onboarding. sprint-ish. who can triage a few?
link-scan-bot: automated: 22 dead links detected in /runtime and /onboarding. report: https://intranet/reports/191919 (auto-generated) :robot_face:
sam: I can take a first pass on the runtime guide. will open small PRs for the obvious 403s.
maria: I can handle onboarding screenshots and shortlinks — will rehost or swap to canonical URLs. ping me if you want ownership swapped.
anya: thanks — Sam, can you ping @lucas for runtime section CRs? he touched the YAML examples last quarter.
sam: yep — @lucas can you eyeball `docs/runtime/batching.md` fixes? mostly sed + rehost images.
lucas: on it. if images are 403s i prefer rehosting to the shared `docs-assets` S3 bucket (public-read). will add a note in the PR about provenance.
devex: quick local commands that help: `rg -n "href=|src=.*s3" docs/ | sed -n '1,200p'` or run `./scripts/link-check --path docs/runtime` before opening a PR.
maria: putting a tiny checklist in PR body: - reproduce the broken link - confirm owner (codeowners/frontmatter) - rehost or replace - keep PR <5 files - assign to owner
anya: also, prefer branch naming `docs/linkfix/1919191919` for grouping, and add label `kb:urgent` if the broken link affects a runbook or customer flow.
sam: making PR now. will add `@lucas` as reviewer and `@maria` for onboarding-related bits. ETA ~1.5h :clock1:
lucas: quick Q — a lot of anchors changed after the TOC rework; for runbooks, should we add frontmatter redirects instead of editing lots of callers?
anya: yes, frontmatter redirects are fine for runbooks. prefer redirects when callers are many and it's low-risk.
devex: noted — CI anchor-lint is on backlog. I can try to land a warn in the next sprint. for now please run the local checker.
link-scan-bot: follow-up scan scheduled in 24h. results will be posted back to #docs.
sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3251 — small sed + image rehost; assigned to `lucas`.
maria: PR opened for onboarding: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3252 — swapped shortlinks for canonical urls and rehosted two images.
anya: awesome, thank you. i'll follow up with owners for any policy/legal question re: assets. very appreciated :tada:
